name: 25914-basetraffic-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), x86 host.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 800 requests / 900 s safety, warmup 10% and cooldown 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, `request_format: plain`. Prompt exactly 32 tokens and output exactly 128 (min = max on both, ignore_eos set), temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, prefix caching off.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter chat assistant giving short single-turn replies to eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf

enable-lora: true

max-loras: 1
max-lora-rank: 16

enable-prefix-caching: false

max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: float16

max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
